questions.question: Paul describes Jesus as having what attitude that believers should imitate?
options: He withdrew from the world to live apart in silence
He sought after power and authority over the nations
He made himself nothing, taking the form of a servant
He grasped and held tightly to his equal place with God
questions.answer: He made himself nothing, taking the form of a servant
